svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One blank 322 x 60 mm back with a 39 x 50 mm flange on each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 54 mm fan holes, centred 30 mm up, 81 mm and 241 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end of the back; cut with a hole saw or step drill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fan screw holes 3.4 mm on a 50 mm square round each fan hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold each end flange 90 degrees forward, square to the back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3.4 mm holes in each flange, 3 mm from the free end (in line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the spine), 15 and 35 mm up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit the fans to the back first, screws from the inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the flanges lie on the spine ends; the back stands 3 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind the fins; the bottom edge rests on the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the flange holes line up with the tapped holes in the spine.
